_meta.description: Reference-quality prompt catalog for Korean modern folk illustration style. Target aesthetic: pastel crayon texture, flat illustration, cream paper, muted earth tones, stylized round-faced characters, hand-drawn warmth (think modern Korean children's-book illustrators).
_meta.style_token: Korean modern illustrator children's book style, flat illustration with crayon and color pencil texture, soft pastel palette (cream beige, sage green, mustard yellow, terracotta orange, dusty blue), stylized round-faced figures with simple features, hand-drawn warm lines, gentle muted earth tones, modern Korean folk illustration aesthetic, soft watercolor wash, cozy nostalgic mood
_meta.negative_default: photorealistic, 3d render, harsh shadows, glossy, plastic, oversaturated, neon, sharp details, text, watermark, signature, blurry, low quality, deformed
